headline: Micron’s Memory Boom Is Heading For A Peak, Analyst Warns
summary: Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) stock gained about 1% in Monday premarket trading as technology stocks moved higher ahead of the opening bell. Nasdaq futures rose 0.41%, while S&P 500 futures gained 0.17%.The move comes as investors weigh Micron’s longer-term growth prospects against expectations for slowing memory pricing momentum and rising competition from Chinese manufacturers.On Aug. 7, Citigroup analyst Atif Malik maintained a Buy rating on Micron but lowered his price forecast to $1,1

headline: JPMorgan Strategists Raise S&P 500 Target as AI Capex Pays Off
summary: (Bloomberg) -- JPMorgan Chase & Co. strategists raised their S&P 500 Index forecast for a second time in two months, citing strong corporate earnings and the payoff from massive artificial intelligence spending.
